sections.content_markdown: 1. Why is the work done by frictional force is always negative?
2. If a spring is cut into two pieces will the spring constant $k$ of the pieces increase or decrease?
3. To keep the earth dynamic which one is necessary? Energy or power?
4. Can mass be considered as energy?
5. If velocity is increased by $1\%$, what will be the percentage increase of kinetic energy?
6. A match stick is rubbed with its box with a force of $5\text{ N}$. The stick is dragged $5\text{ cm}$.
(a) What is the energy used in rubbing?
(b) What is the power needed if it takes $0.5\text{ s}$ to drag the stick?

7. The reservoir of a hydro-electric project is $800\text{ m}$ high from the sea level and the power station is $250\text{ m}$ high. The water of a reservoir rotates a turbine coming through the pipe. There is $20 \times 10^8$ liter water in the reservoir. If the mass of $1\text{ liter}$ water is $1\text{ kg}$, find the potential energy stored in the water of the reservoir.
8. A boy of $40\text{ kg}$ can reach the roof top using the stairs in $12\text{ s}$. The number of steps of the stairs is $20$ and the height of each step is $20\text{ cm}$.
(a) What is the weight of the boy?
(b) What is the height reached by the boy?
(c) What is the work done to reach the roof top?
(d) What is the power he uses to reach the roof?
9. It is more advantageous to produce nuclear energy than the power station that uses fuel because no greenhouse gas is produced.
(a) What are the other advantages of using nuclear energy?
(b) What are the disadvantages of using nuclear energy?
